title: Dulles brothers draft the Versailles war reparations

tellings.quote: and actually as lawyers at Sullivan and Cromwell that to draft into the into the Verasai treaty agreement the war reparations requirements

plain: The brothers Allen Dulles, later head of the CIA, and John Foster Dulles, later Secretary of State, wrote the war reparations terms into the Treaty of Versailles, signed in 1919, according to the lawyer Dan Sheehan. Sheehan tells Michels, without naming a source, that they did it as young lawyers at Sullivan and Cromwell, a New York law firm, with family ties to two former Secretaries of State, their uncle Robert Lansing and grandfather John W. Foster. He tells it as an early sign of how far the brothers' reach went.
